import json
records = [json.loads(l) for l in open('data/verified_tone_pilot.jsonl') if l.strip()]
n = len(records)

# NLI pass rates
nli_cf_pass = sum(1 for r in records if r['nli_cf'] >= 0.90) / n
nli_dr_pass = sum(1 for r in records if r['nli_dr'] >= 0.90) / n
bs_cf_pass = sum(1 for r in records if r['bertscore_cf'] >= 0.92) / n
bs_dr_pass = sum(1 for r in records if r['bertscore_dr'] >= 0.92) / n
both_cf_pass = sum(1 for r in records if r['passed_cf']) / n
both_dr_pass = sum(1 for r in records if r['passed_dr']) / n

print(f'=== Tone Axis Pilot Results (n={n}) ===')
print(f'')
print(f'--- Pass Rates ---')
print(f'NLI CF pass (>=0.90):       {nli_cf_pass:.1%} ({sum(1 for r in records if r[\"nli_cf\"] >= 0.90)}/{n})')
print(f'NLI DR pass (>=0.90):       {nli_dr_pass:.1%} ({sum(1 for r in records if r[\"nli_dr\"] >= 0.90)}/{n})')
print(f'BERTScore CF pass (>=0.92): {bs_cf_pass:.1%} ({sum(1 for r in records if r[\"bertscore_cf\"] >= 0.92)}/{n})')
print(f'BERTScore DR pass (>=0.92): {bs_dr_pass:.1%} ({sum(1 for r in records if r[\"bertscore_dr\"] >= 0.92)}/{n})')
print(f'Both CF pass:               {both_cf_pass:.1%} ({sum(1 for r in records if r[\"passed_cf\"])}/{n})')
print(f'Both DR pass:               {both_dr_pass:.1%} ({sum(1 for r in records if r[\"passed_dr\"])}/{n})')

print(f'')
print(f'--- Score Distributions ---')
import statistics
for metric in ['bertscore_cf','bertscore_dr','nli_cf','nli_dr']:
    vals = [r[metric] for r in records]
    print(f'{metric:15s}: mean={statistics.mean(vals):.4f} std={statistics.stdev(vals):.4f} min={min(vals):.4f} max={max(vals):.4f}')

print(f'')
print(f'--- By Detected Tone ---')
for pole in ['assertive', 'hedging']:
    subset = [r for r in records if r.get('original_tone') == pole]
    if not subset:
        continue
    ns = len(subset)
    nli_cf_p = sum(1 for r in subset if r['nli_cf'] >= 0.90) / ns
    nli_dr_p = sum(1 for r in subset if r['nli_dr'] >= 0.90) / ns
    both_cf_p = sum(1 for r in subset if r['passed_cf']) / ns
    both_dr_p = sum(1 for r in subset if r['passed_dr']) / ns
    print(f'  {pole} (n={ns}):')
    print(f'    NLI CF pass: {nli_cf_p:.1%}, NLI DR pass: {nli_dr_p:.1%}')
    print(f'    Both CF pass: {both_cf_p:.1%}, Both DR pass: {both_dr_p:.1%}')
    print(f'    BERTScore CF mean: {statistics.mean([r[\"bertscore_cf\"] for r in subset]):.4f}')
    print(f'    NLI CF mean: {statistics.mean([r[\"nli_cf\"] for r in subset]):.4f}')

print(f'')
print(f'--- Threshold Sweep (NLI CF) ---')
for thresh in [0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95]:
    p = sum(1 for r in records if r['nli_cf'] >= thresh) / n
    print(f'  NLI >= {thresh:.2f}: {p:.1%} ({sum(1 for r in records if r[\"nli_cf\"] >= thresh)}/{n})')

print(f'')
print(f'--- Threshold Sweep (Both CF) ---')
for nli_t in [0.80, 0.85, 0.90]:
    for bs_t in [0.88, 0.90, 0.92]:
        p = sum(1 for r in records if r['nli_cf'] >= nli_t and r['bertscore_cf'] >= bs_t) / n
        print(f'  NLI>={nli_t:.2f} & BS>={bs_t:.2f}: {p:.1%} ({sum(1 for r in records if r[\"nli_cf\"] >= nli_t and r[\"bertscore_cf\"] >= bs_t)}/{n})')

print(f'')
print(f'--- Failed Records Detail ---')
for r in records:
    if not r['passed_cf']:
        print(f'  id={r[\"id\"]}: tone={r.get(\"original_tone\",\"?\")} bs_cf={r[\"bertscore_cf\"]:.4f} nli_cf={r[\"nli_cf\"]:.4f}')
